Thanks for contributing to Statamic! 💜 A few quick things before you submit:

- First PR? Please read the [contribution guide](https://statamic.dev/contribution-guide).
- Target the current release branch (e.g. `6.x`), or `master` if your PR includes a breaking change.
- Prefix your PR title with the version you're targeting, e.g. `[6.x] Fix something`.
- Include tests where possible. PRs with tests get reviewed and merged much faster.
- Used AI tools? Please review the changes carefully before submitting.

Replace this text with a description of what your PR does and why.
